description.value: Jägerhof is a long-established Alpine-cuisine restaurant in North Vancouver serving authentic German, Austrian, Swiss, and South Tyrol dishes such as Wiener Schnitzel, Beef Rouladen, and Swiss Raclette. Reopened in 2014 by local owners who grew up visiting the original, it retains a cozy European atmosphere complete with a 125-year-old piano and regular live music on weekend evenings. Now celebrating 40 years, it pairs its regional menu with a carefully curated selection of European imported beers and wines.
